# S8–S10: Quotes, follow and share, footer

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high. **Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/scenes/S8-S10.md, and do S8–S10. Stop for my review at the key frames, and again at the end.`
**Spec:** `sed -n 453,489p PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` (S8, S9, S10). Shared rules: [README.md](README.md). Can run in parallel with S7 in a git worktree.

## Purpose
- **S8:** voices: one quote per 100vh, centred.
- **S9:** follow CJP and share the piece.
- **S10:** credit, methodology, disclaimer and the numbered sources that every `*` on the page links to.

## Added by the S5 chat (2026-11-12)
- `data/story/sansad_chalo.json` `new_sources[]` (20 sources) are appended to `data.sources.sources` at runtime by S5 (`s05-map.js` init), numbered after sources.json. S10 must render them (or fold them into sources.json via the F1 generator with Vali's OK) so the 20 Jul `*` links resolve.
- Photo credits: `data/story/imagery.json` items and people credits shown in the S5 cards must also appear in S10's credits.

## Allowed data keys
- S8: `quotes.quotes[]` where `selected: true` (3 today: Ambedkar, Bhagat Singh, Faiz), each with `text, original_text, roman, language, author, work, translator, translation_is_ours, source_url, source_note`. **Omit `year`** (not verified). Verbatim; Faiz is in copyright, so keep the excerpt exactly as given (fair dealing).
- S9: `meta.handles[]` where `show: true` (Instagram, X), `meta.handles_status`.
- S10: `meta.designer_credit`, `methodology.*` (statuses, attribution, asterisk, crowd_tiers, roach_size, founder_roach, collection_dates, caveats, disputed_claims, map, illustrative_graphics), `methodology.disclaimer` **verbatim, unedited**, `sources.sources[]` (numbered in file order; `byId.source[id].n`), image credits from the timeline/people media entries, the OSM/ODbL credit from `data/map/base.json` `meta.attribution`.

## Files it owns
- `src/scenes/s08-quotes.js` (**one factory**, `def.sub` = quote index; the budget makes one 100vh scene per selected quote: S8a, S8b, S8c), `src/scenes/s09-cta.js`, `src/scenes/s10-footer.js` (+ CSS).
- The page `<head>` meta (title, description, Open Graph, Twitter card) is spec S9: propose the tags to Vali; `v3/index.html` is shell-owned, so the edit needs Vali's OK.

## Must not touch
The common list in README.

## Contracts it consumes
- S8 is one pinned block (`S8`, stage `quotes`) holding all the quote scenes; crossfade inside each scene's `p` (only one quote scene is live at a time).
- S9 (100vh) and S10 (`auto`) are flow sections: `ctx.root` is the page section; S10 is the last thing on the page (S10 p 1 = page end). Remove the placeholder `min-height` on S10.
- The `*` convention (`methodology.asterisk`): every `*` on the page links to its footer entry and each entry links back. Earlier scenes already emit `star(source_ids, data.byId.source, label)` from `src/lib/star.js` (F3), which links to `#src-N` (N = `byId.source[id].n`, sources.json order). **S10 renders each source entry with `id="src-N"`** plus a back-link, and owns `star.js` from here on (keep its output stable). Check every `.star` on the page resolves.
- Fonts: `--font-urdu` (Noto Nastaliq Urdu, RTL) and `--font-deva` (Noto Sans Devanagari) are self-hosted.

## Key frames
| p | Expected picture | Storyboard |
|---|---|---|
| S8a 0.5, S8b 0.5 | Quotes 1 and 2, centred, no role label. | none |
| S8c 0.5 | Faiz "Bol": centred; Urdu original (RTL) above the English; author, work, translation credit, source; a single roach idles on the attribution rule. | `ink-S8.png` |
| S9 1 | One solid button per shown handle; share row (copy link is the red primary, with a toast; native share when available; X, WhatsApp, LinkedIn intents). **No headline** (empty slot). Roaches only in the margins. | `ink-S9.png` |
| S10 `top` | Three underlined headings (Credit, Methodology, Disclaimer), then the numbered Sources. Paper reading section. | `ink-S10.png` |

## Done when
- Every quote verbatim with attribution and a working source link; no role chip.
- All links resolve (`rel="noopener noreferrer"`, new tab); copy link works; no tracking scripts.
- Every `*` on the page resolves to a footer entry and back; no unused sources; the disclaimer is present without edits.
- QA both ways (`targets/S8.json`, `S9.json`, `S10.json`), compare sheets, `qa-shell` all PASS.

## Vali's notes
- S8 quotes are **centred, no role label** ("POET") (2026-11-12). Activist and poet quotes beyond the selected three stay out.
- S9 headline: none until Vali supplies one; leave the slot empty (2026-11-12).
- Handles: Instagram and X (@Cockroachisback) only.
